direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, a cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never any other hue; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum and no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with depth and bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with cross marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade shows living emerald flow, then silver OFFLINE wave, then recovery restart across every department
